note: THE SCOPE MAP: what a release's diff requires of the gate. Owner, 2026-10-07: 'we may optimize our acceptance a bit depending on what we touch and run full fault injection path and all install variants only when we touch certain things or once in 10 updates or so.' Read by tools/gate-scope.py, which refuses a cut the gate's coverage does not cover. Decided with Jev (scratchpad/tiering/answers.json): an UNMAPPED path requires the FULL set (0.97), the floor trips on whichever of four conditions comes first (0.96), and the enforcement computes and refuses rather than being written down (1.00). Patterns are fnmatch, matched against repo-relative paths, longest pattern first; a path matching none of them is UNMAPPED and forces the full set, naming the file.

core.reason: Every release can break these whatever was edited: the package's own identity, the two install entry paths users actually take on the primary target, the route that tells dom0 an error happened, and the sweep that reads the guest's logs afterwards. Jev 0.60 over 'package+sweep only' (0.08) and 'all eight cells always' (0.14).

full.reason: Everything. Required by the floor, by an unmapped path, and by any pattern below that asks for it.

floor.reason: Whichever comes first, plus a failed previous full run, plus a change to this file. Releases alone would let a quiet month drift (4.3.33, 4.3.34 and 4.3.35 were cut in five days; before that a fortnight passed); days alone would let a burst of ten releases through on one full run. 21 days is three weeks - longer than any gap between the last ten releases, short enough that a regression cannot sit unmeasured for a month.

packaging/setup/**.reason: the installer itself decides every install path, including the ones only a reinstall or an upgrade reaches

packaging/patch-installer-*.ps1.reason: a build-time patch to the MSI changes what every install does

packaging/make-setup.ps1.reason: it decides what ships; a file left out is invisible until a guest misses it

packaging/make-package.ps1.reason: as above, for the overlay channel

packaging/stage-qwt-repo.ps1.reason: it substitutes our binaries into the MSI

packaging/**.reason: other packaging work still reaches both clean paths and the upgrade

patches/**.reason: a patch applies to pinned upstream source at build time; its effect is only visible on a guest

.github/workflows/**.reason: the workflows decide what is built and packaged at all

agent/gui-agent/lifecycle.*.reason: the agent/service lifecycle contract governs every boot and shutdown of every cell

agent/watchdog/**.reason: the service that launches the agent; a mistake here costs the GUI on every guest

agent/include/**.reason: shared between the agent and its service

agent/gui-agent/errbox*.reason: the in-guest error window, the route's fallback

agent/gui-agent/**.reason: the agent is in every window dom0 shows

agent/**.reason: anything else in the fork still ships inside the agent

tools/wgcbroker/**.reason: the de-slice broker IS the capture engine on an eligible guest; its hang detection is what failproof-faultinject drives

tools/notifhost/**.reason: the notification bridge and the error route's sender

guest/install-updater-agent.ps1.reason: it deploys the updater into a guest

guest/qubes-updates-relay.cs.reason: the relay the updater serves through

guest/pvnic-selfprime.ps1.reason: the PV NIC priming latch, exercised by an AppVM with a netvm

guest/set-autologon.ps1.reason: without autologon a guest sits at the sign-in screen

guest/health-check.ps1.reason: the guest self-check every cell grades

guest/**.reason: a guest script that ships at all is reached by a clean install

mgmt/harness/**.reason: the harness is the instrument, not the product: its own self-tests and lint cover it, and a harness change cannot ship to a user

tools/tests/**.reason: offline suites, run in CI on every push

tools/hooks/**.reason: session hooks on the dev qube

tools/**.reason: dev-qube tooling; the shipped helpers are matched by their own patterns above

.githooks/**.reason: commit-time checks on the dev qube

.gitmodules.reason: it decides which fork a build takes its agent from

dom0/**.reason: dom0-side services the owner installs by hand; not part of the guest package

agent.reason: a submodule pointer change is the whole diff of that submodule: its files are mapped by the agent/** patterns above
